item.description:

Field Value

Authentication Required Yes — low-privilege Subscriber-level WordPress account
Network Access Required Yes

Summary

Simple History exposes a REST “reaction” endpoint (/wp-json/simple-history/v1/events/{id}/react) that is missing proper authorization checks when the plugin’s experimental features are enabled. A low-privileged, authenticated Subscriber can call this endpoint against arbitrary audit-log event IDs and request the context field, which can include the full body of password-reset notification emails logged by the plugin — including the reset key and target username. With that data the attacker can construct a valid password-reset URL for any user, including administrators, achieving full account takeover.
